correctness.rationale: The closed directed incoming-ball definition and indexed binary words are unambiguous. Every prefix pair u0,u1 has identical positive-length predecessor sets; coverage/separation forces at least one sensor per pair and the sharp half-vertex lower bound. The actual three hex-coded witnesses were reinterpreted independently from WITNESSES.json and all 32/128/512 targets were reverse-BFS enumerated on direct shift edges, giving 32/128/512 nonempty distinct signatures, sizes 16/64/256 and minimum signature sizes 3/4/12. Thus all three exact finite optima are proven; no generalization to larger t follows.
